LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Obelisk.label: obelisk
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Obelisk.description: A single needle of dressed stone covered in carved columns of signs and capped with a gilded point that shines at sunrise.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SenetTable.label: senet table
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SenetTable.description: A low table of ebony and ivory with a board of thirty squares and a drawer for the pieces. Two colonists sit at it to play.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_PapyrusWorkshop.label: papyrus workshop
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_PapyrusWorkshop.description: A reed-splitting table, a beating stone and drying racks. It turns dried grass and reeds into papyrus sheets.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Sphinx.label: sphinx
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Sphinx.description: A lion with the head of a king, wearing the striped royal headcloth, carved to keep watch over a gate or a tomb. Kemet says its builders still dream behind its eyes.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LotusLamp.label: lotus lamp
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LotusLamp.description: A bronze stand crowned with an open lotus flower that holds an oil flame. The lotus closes at night and opens at dawn, and so does the light of Kemet.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon_Gun.label: pylon bows
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon_Gun.description: The turning top of the archer pylon.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon.label: archer pylon
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon.description: A sloped sandstone tower top painted with blue bands, where four composite bows on a turning stand shoot together. The volley is quick but the arrows are light. Wood for new arrows: one log makes two.
